'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Aaron Kingery DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Aaron Kingery]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name on sheet: I play tested this. Defensive Shields section blank on sheet.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Endor Operations / Establish Secret Base]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
